aiTexts: The Beneunder Lightweight Expandable Travel Bag features a plain nylon design with top handle for easy carrying.
Made from multifunctional waterproof, oil-proof, and stain-resistant fabric, it withstands wind, rain, and dirt effectively.
Durable construction supports up to 50 kg and resists wear with over 40,000 abrasion cycles and strong tear resistance.
Weighing just 220 grams, it offers lightweight portability equivalent to a cup of water.
Available in two sizes, it can be carried by hand or worn on the shoulder, ideal for travelers needing large capacity and durable protection.

Clothing Storage Bag

13749477100.detail_text: Travel Bag Category As a travel bag, it fits perfectly into the category of luggage and accessories, suitable for both men and women. Expandable Feature The expandable feature allows you to increase the bag's volume when needed, providing flexibility for different travel needs. Lightweight Design Despite its large capacity, the bag is surprisingly lightweight, making it easy to carry around and ideal for those who value convenience. Large Capacity This travel bag boasts a generous capacity, perfect for short trips or business outings. Its spacious design ensures all essentials are within reach. Oxford Cloth Material Crafted from durable Oxford cloth, this travel bag offers exceptional strength and longevity, ideal for frequent travelers.

Travel Bag Category

product.desc:
⭐ NANOBAG OFFICIAL STORE | Ultralight & Ultra-Strong Reusable Bags

Welcome to the Official Nanobag Store on LazMall. Say goodbye to bulky bags and single-use plastic with the world's most portable and durable reusable shopping solution.

💎 The Nano Advantage: Facts & Specifications

Every Nanobag is engineered with premium technical fabric to guarantee unmatched strength and portability.



  • Material & Feel: Made from Unique Super-Soft Diamond Ripstop Nylon, which is silky smooth, exceptionally durable, and minimizes folding bulk.
  • Ultralight Thickness: Only 0.05mm thick, allowing it to effortlessly fit into the smallest pockets or purses.
  • Extreme Load Capacity: Reliably holds up to 66 lbs. (30 kg), strong enough for large grocery hauls or heavy travel gear.
  • Guaranteed Durability: Features Double-stitched piping & Bartack stitching to ensure longevity and tear resistance at stress points.
  • Easy Folding: Densely compacts into its own integrated pouch (no complex folding required—just stuff and go).



​



Our collection ensures you have the perfect ultralight bag for any situation:

  • Nanobag Standard & XL: The essential, pocket-sized shopping totes.
  • Nanosling: The lightweight cross-body bag for quick trips and daily essentials.
  • Nanopack & Daypack: Full-sized, durable backpacks that pack down to fit in your palm.
  • Nanobag Micro: Our smallest design, perfect for keys or clipping to a keychain..



    ​

🌱 Our Commitment to the Planet

We believe in making a positive impact with every purchase:

  • Tree Planting Initiative: One tree is planted for every Nanobag sold, in partnership with Eden People + Planet.



    ​

📦 Official Store Logistics

  • Guarantee: Purchase with confidence from the verified Nanobag Official Store..



    ​

Waterproof Design The PGM Golf Bag features a waterproof design, ensuring your equipment stays dry during rainy weather. Thick Hard Shell Equipped with a thick hard shell, this bag provides robust protection for your golf equipment against impacts and scratches. Foldable Feature Its foldable feature allows for easy storage and transport, making it convenient for travel and storage. Protective Cover The protective cover not only shields your golf balls but also keeps your other golf equipment safe and secure.

Rod Bag Included The package includes a rod bag, offering additional storage for your golf clubs and other accessories. Airbag Protection The airbag design offers superior protection for your golf balls, reducing the risk of damage during transit. Thickened Design The PGM Golf Airbag features a thickened design for extra durability, ensuring your equipment remains protected during travel. Foldable Feature This golf bag comes with a foldable feature, making it easy to store when not in use and saving space in your luggage.

aiTexts: This Mixi Foldable Travel Bag is designed for convenient, space-saving travel with a compact foldable size of 50 x 30 x 19 cm.
Expandable capacity adjusts from 58L to 90L or 120L with two extra layers, accommodating varying packing needs.
Constructed with durable, wear-resistant, scratch-resistant, and water-repellent fabric for long-lasting protection.
Equipped with four non-detachable wheels on a sturdy base, it glides smoothly over uneven surfaces for easy portability.
Features multiple pockets including a spacious main compartment, front zipper, and side mesh pockets for organized storage.
Adjustable straps and handles provide comfortable carrying options, ideal for weekend trips, business, or family travel.

product.highlights:
• FOLDABLE: This Mixi travel bag can be folds down to a compact 50 x 30 x 19 cm easy-to-store pouch when not in use, greatly saving the storage space.
  • EXPANDABLE: This luggage bag is flexible to meet your various travel needs with extra 2-layer expansions. It can be expanded up to 90L or 120L from a basic 58L capacity.
  • PORTABLE: Compared with hardside suitcases of the same capacity, the travel bag is lighter to carry. Equipped with 4 non-detachable wheels on a hard bottom, it is easy to slide on rough or uneven surfaces.
  • DURABLE: This travel duffel bag is made of high quality fabric, which is wear-resistant, scratch-resistant and water-repellent, providing you with excellent protection and withstand the demands of frequent travel use.
  • CONVENIENT: Besides spacious main pocket, this travel bag has 1 front zipper pocket and 2 side mesh pockets to easily store and access items. Adjustable straps and handle help adjusting comfort and carry methods.
  • VERSATILE: This rolling travel bag easily meets the needs of various occasions such as weekend trips, business trips, family trip, consignment, house-moving. It is the perfect choice for your travel anytime and anywhere!
